How to play

  1. A block slides back and forth above the tower.
  2. Tap to drop it. It falls straight down and lands with real physics.
  3. Land it near the middle of the block below (the amber arrow) for a Perfect! bonus.
  4. Hang a block too far over the edge and it tips off. Anything that falls past the base ends the game.
  5. The block speeds up as the tower grows. How high can you go?
